audience: A stage manager with a damaged set piece.
positioning: A repair shop that lets the stage manager see the plan before approving work.
decision: Owner to assess RB-2 using the scenic-flat intake proof. Supply an original logo before external release.

production.direction: Make the actual damaged scenic flat the dominant image. Set the short instruction against a clean field and keep the photo-intake action legible without reading the procedure. At phone size, preserve the link between the marked joint in context and its enlarged detail.
production.relationship: The stage manager submits context and detail of the same split joint. The shop inspects it, then the stage manager approves the repair plan.
production.assets: Use the cleared editable rivet-intake-plate.svg and its PNG export. The supplied drawing is evidence about this shop's actual intake method. Use the shop name in type until an original logo is supplied.
production.acceptance: At first scan point to the split joint in the full flat and in the detail. A stage manager should know the two photos to take and who approves a repair. Inspect the rendered page at mobile and print sizes. Keep the turnaround estimate out of published copy.

sources.locator: Practice brief, Repairs website capture, intake and action
sources.excerpt: The shop accepts a photo, inspects the joint and sends a repair plan before the stage manager approves the work.

sources.locator: rivet-intake-plate.svg, base field, inspection marker and callout paths
sources.excerpt: Visual observation: the rear framing and the close view show the same open joint. The colored mark locates the break in both views.
Never promise a completion date before inspection.
An earlier generic serif sheet on a warm paper field was rejected.

voice.rule: Name the part or action a stage manager recognizes.
voice.after: Send a photo of the break.

voice.rule: Describe the next decision. Give a completion date only after inspection.
voice.before: Get your set back in two days.
voice.after: Review the repair plan before work starts.

portable.rule: Name the stage manager's next decision.
portable.before: The repair process will be initiated.
portable.after: Review the plan before we start the repair.

visual.rule: Show the rear of the scenic flat and enlarge the same opened joint. The marked location links the photographs the shop needs.
The original logo and company-wide type specification are unavailable. Use a text wordmark for the proof.
Keep context and close-up together and make the photo intake easy to find on the first scan. Give each of the three process labels a different job.

sheet.headline: Show us the break.

device.alt: Back of a stage flat with a split at the middle rail and right upright. The enlarged joint includes two screw heads on each side of the break.
device.visible_words: Stage flat. Show all four back corners. Move in on the split. Keep both rows of screws in view.
device.meaning: A wide view locates a break in the scenic frame; a close-up of the same joint gives the bench details the wide shot cannot show.

sheet.action_note: You receive a plan before work starts.

deck.detail: Only the supplied page 2 excerpt is available.

website.detail: Repairs text and intake link, captured offline. No live submission.

ink.basis: Specified as annotation ink in the cleared flat drawing; applies to this repair-intake piece only.

paper.basis: The drawing is specified on a white working surface. A company-wide canvas color is unknown.

action.basis: Repeat the drawing's inspection marker for the photo action. Its use on buttons is a new application awaiting review.

font_stack.basis: Use an available sans for the instructions. The shop supplied no company-wide face; do not treat the proof font as policy.

heading_font_stack.basis: Use weight and scale to distinguish the instruction from captions. The drawing's condensed labels are local to that drawing.

design_spec.substitution_test: Cover the shop name. A reviewer must still identify the rear of a scenic flat and point to the corresponding split joint in both views. A bicycle-shop intake would require a new image and new callouts.

owner_rejections.instruction: The former generic serif and warm paper treatment was rejected for this piece. Preserve the technical intake drawing as the focal point.
